aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Hearing Loss VCEP Version 2.0 (GN005) specifications for autosomal recessive USH2A and combined using ACMG/AMP 2015 + ClinGen SVI 2020 combining rules (as GN005 defines no separate points/combining table). Applied strength counts: Pathogenic = 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting); Benign = 0 BA1, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 0 Supporting; acmg_score = 1. Neither Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic nor Benign/Likely Benign combining thresholds are reached, so the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic) based on net positive pathogenic weight (+1 from PM2_Supporting with zero benign criteria met). Computational score REVEL=0.556 falls in the indeterminate zone between GN005 thresholds (<=0.15 for BP4, >=0.70 for PP3) with SpliceAI max_delta=0, and retrieved published cases either lacked a second USH2A variant (PMID:28224992, PMID:36785559) or carried c.5516T>A unphased as a third allele alongside c.2299delG and c.4714C>T (PMID:28944237), preventing application of PM3 or PP4.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Epilepsy Sodium Channel VCEP specifications for SCN1A v2.0 (GN067; PMID:42227234). Strength tally: 0 Pathogenic Very Strong, 1 Pathogenic Strong (PVS1_Strong), 0 Pathogenic Moderate, 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting), and 0 Benign criteria (acmg_score = 5). Because the variant lies in the last coding exon of NM_001165963.4 (coding exon 26 / transcript exon 29, starting at c.4853) and is predicted to escape NMD, PVS1 cannot be applied at Very Strong per Tayoun et al. (2018) as mandated by GN067; instead, PVS1 is applied at Strong because truncation after Pro1837 removes the functionally critical C-terminal calmodulin-binding IQ domain (aa 1915-1944) and residues harboring pathogenic Dravet variants. Under GN067 combining rules (and likewise under generic ACMG/AMP 2015 rules and the ClinGen Bayesian points scale where 5 points < 6 for Likely Pathogenic), 1 Strong + 1 Supporting does not reach Likely Pathogenic or Pathogenic, yielding VUS (leaning pathogenic). Note: the submitted HGVS string NM_001165963.4:c.5511del indicates a 1-bp deletion whereas the GRCh37 VCF coordinates 2:166848274:CGG:C represent a 2-bp deletion (ENST00000303395.4:c.5509_5510del, p.Pro1837AlafsTer23); both represent last-exon frameshifts at codon 1837 with identical ACMG criterion outcomes.

aiva_evidence.BP5: Not met per GN125: not observed in a case with an established alternate molecular basis for PAH.
aiva_evidence.BP7: Not met per GN125: BP4 is not met because SpliceAI predicts splice acceptor loss (max_delta=0.978 >0.1) per annotate_variant (VEP), and no negative RNA splicing assay exists.

aiva_rationale: Under the ClinGen Pulmonary Hypertension VCEP BMPR2 Version 2.0 specifications (GN125), three Pathogenic Supporting criteria are met (PS4 at Supporting [+1], PM2 at Supporting [+1], and PP3 at Supporting [+1]; 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 3 Supporting pathogenic; 0 benign), yielding an ACMG/AMP points score of +3. Per GN125 points_rules (Pathogenic >=10, Likely Pathogenic 6 to 9, Uncertain Significance -1 to 5, Likely Benign -2 to -6, Benign <=-7), a score of +3 classifies NM_001204.7:c.968-3C>G as Uncertain Significance, specifically VUS (leaning pathogenic) because all met evidence is pathogenic-leaning. Although SpliceAI strongly predicts intron 7 acceptor loss (DS_AL=0.978), position -3 lies outside canonical +/-1,2 splice sites and no patient mRNA/RNA splicing assay is available to apply PVS1(RNA) or PS3.

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Met at Very Strong per ClinGen VHL VCEP GN078: annotate_variant (VEP, GRCh37) maps 3:10188265 TGT>T to frameshift ENST00000256474.2:c.410_411del (p.Val137AlafsTer6) in exon 2 after Met54 within the critical 1st Beta/Nuclear Export domain (AA 63-154) and disrupting the Alpha (AA 155-192) and 2nd Beta (AA 193-204) domains (input HGVS NM_000551.4:c.408del is likewise a codon 136-137 frameshift predicted to undergo NMD per GN078); LOF is established for VHL disease per GN078 and PubTator3 (gnomad_constraint pLI=0.0325, LOEUF=0.885 noted as inconclusive for tumor suppressors).
aiva_evidence.PS1: Not met: frameshift deletion, not a same-amino-acid nucleotide substitution matching a VHL VCEP-established pathogenic variant per GN078.
aiva_evidence.PS2: Not met: no de novo parental confirmation data provided in clinical context or PubTator3 literature search per GN078.
aiva_evidence.PS3: Not met: no VHL functional studies (HIF1/2a degradation, VBC stability, or ECM/fibronectin assays) identified for p.Val137AlafsTer6/c.410_411del or c.408del in PubTator3 per GN078.
aiva_evidence.PS4: Not met: no documented VHL proband clinical scoring data or case-control prevalence identified in clinical context or PubTator3 for p.Val137AlafsTer6/c.410_411del (PMID:34923986 lists c.408del in a mutation summary without individual proband phenotypes) per GN078.
aiva_evidence.PM1: Not applicable: GN078 restricts PM1 to putative missense variants in germline/somatic hotspots or key functional domains, whereas this is a frameshift deletion.
aiva_evidence.PM2: Met at Supporting (PM2_Supporting) per ClinGen VHL VCEP GN078: absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant (both VEP and MyVariant queries succeeded with no gnomAD allele frequency record, meeting <=0.00000156 GroupMax FAF).
aiva_evidence.PM3: Not applicable: GN078 marks PM3 Not Applicable for autosomal dominant VHL disease.
aiva_evidence.PM4: Not applicable: GN078 applies PM4 only to in-frame indels in Beta/Alpha domains and stop-loss extensions, whereas this is an out-of-frame frameshift deletion.
aiva_evidence.PM5: Not applicable: GN078 restricts PM5 to missense variants evaluated by Grantham distance, whereas this is a frameshift deletion.
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not met: no assumed de novo observations provided in clinical context or PubTator3 literature search per GN078.
aiva_evidence.PP1: Not met: no family co-segregation data available in clinical context or PubTator3 literature search per GN078.
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not applicable: GN078 marks PP2 Not Applicable for VHL (gnomad_constraint confirms mis_z=-0.88, oe_mis_upper=1.23), and this is a frameshift rather than missense variant.
aiva_evidence.PP3: Not met: GN078 applies PP3 to missense variants (REVEL>=0.664) or splice variants (SpliceAI>0.5 and VarSeak class 4-5); this is a frameshift deletion with SpliceAI max_delta=0.001 per annotate_variant (VEP).
aiva_evidence.PP4: Not applicable: GN078 marks PP4 Not Applicable for VHL (combined with PS4 to avoid double counting probands).
aiva_evidence.BA1: Not met: absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant, below the GN078 BA1 cutoff of >=0.000156 GroupMax FAF.
aiva_evidence.BS1: Not met: absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant, below the GN078 BS1 cutoff of >=0.0000156 GroupMax FAF.
aiva_evidence.BS2: Not met: no unaffected adult carriers (>=65 years) reported in clinical context or PubTator3 per GN078.
aiva_evidence.BS3: Not met: no functional assays demonstrating wild-type VHL activity for this variant in PubTator3 per GN078.
aiva_evidence.BS4: Not met: no evidence of non-segregation in affected VHL families in clinical context or PubTator3 per GN078.
aiva_evidence.BP1: Not applicable: GN078 marks BP1 Not Applicable for VHL, and this is a frameshift rather than missense variant.
aiva_evidence.BP2: Not met: no observations in trans, homozygous, or in cis with a known pathogenic VHL variant per GN078.
aiva_evidence.BP3: Not applicable: GN078 restricts BP3 to in-frame indels in the AA 14-48 GXEEX repeat motif, whereas this is a frameshift deletion at codon 137.
aiva_evidence.BP4: Not met: GN078 applies BP4 only to lack of splicing impact requiring concordance of SpliceAI<=0.1 and VarSeak Class 1-2; although SpliceAI max_delta=0.001 per annotate_variant (VEP), VarSeak data are unavailable and this is a coding frameshift variant.
aiva_evidence.BP5: Not met: no co-occurrence with a penetrant pathogenic variant in an alternate gene explaining a non-VHL phenotype per GN078.
aiva_evidence.BP7: Not applicable: GN078 restricts BP7 to silent or intronic variants meeting BP4 with PhyloP<=0.2, whereas this is a frameshift deletion.

aiva_rationale: Applied strength counts under ClinGen VHL VCEP GN078 (v1.1): 1 Pathogenic Very Strong (PVS1), 0 Pathogenic Strong, 0 Pathogenic Moderate, 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting); 0 Benign Stand Alone, 0 Benign Strong, 0 Benign Moderate, 0 Benign Supporting; summary acmg_score=9. Because ClinGen VHL VCEP GN078 combining_rules supersede the generic rules and do not include a 1 Pathogenic Very Strong + 1 Pathogenic Supporting rule for Likely Pathogenic (requiring at least 1 PVS + 1 PM for Likely Pathogenic or 1 PVS + >=2 PP for Pathogenic), no Pathogenic, Likely Pathogenic, Benign, or Likely Benign combining rule fires, yielding VUS (leaning pathogenic). Note that GRCh37 coordinates 3:10188265 TGT>T map via VEP to ENST00000256474.2:c.410_411del (p.Val137AlafsTer6) rather than input HGVS NM_000551.4:c.408del, though both are exon 2 codon 136-137 frameshift deletions absent from gnomAD and yield identical criteria.

aiva_evidence.PS4: Not met: variant is present in gnomAD controls (gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes controls EAS AF=0.001769, AC=16; gnomAD v4.1 joint AC=91 per annotate_variant VEP), failing the GN125 requirement of absence in controls / PM2.
aiva_evidence.PM1: Not met: p.Arg873Gln lies in the C-terminal cytoplasmic tail disordered region (aa 872-972 per UniProt:Q13873), outside the GN125-specified extracellular (aa 33-131) and kinase (aa 203-504) domains.
aiva_evidence.PM2: Not met: highest gnomAD controls subpopulation AF with >=1,000 alleles is 0.1769% (0.001769, AC=16, AN~9,045 in gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes controls EAS; overall controls AF=0.0183%; gnomAD v4.1 joint popmax EAS AF=0.0557%, AC=25/44,880 per annotate_variant VEP), exceeding the GN125 <0.01% threshold.
aiva_evidence.PM3: Not applicable per GN125: BMPR2-related PAH follows autosomal dominant inheritance.
aiva_evidence.PM4: Not applicable: single-nucleotide missense substitution (p.Arg873Gln) with no protein length change per annotate_variant VEP (GN125).
aiva_evidence.PM5: Not met: no different established pathogenic or likely pathogenic missense variant at codon Arg873 is verified in ClinVar or literature per annotate_variant and literature search (GN125).
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not applicable per GN125: confirmation of both maternity and paternity is required.
aiva_evidence.PP1: Not met: no co-segregation data in >=3 affected PAH family members was provided or found in literature (GN125).
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not met: per GN125 BMPR2 is not constrained for missense variants and PP2 requires both PM2_supporting and PP3 to be met, neither of which is met (despite gnomAD mis_z=3.15, oe_mis_upper=0.836 per annotate_variant gnomad_constraint).
aiva_evidence.PP3: Not met: GN125 requires 2/3 of REVEL (>=0.644), AlphaMissense (>=0.792), and CADD (>=25.3); here REVEL=0.551 (VEP/myvariant) and AlphaMissense=0.2661 (VEP) fail while only CADD=26.1 (myvariant) meets threshold (1/3), and SpliceAI max_delta=0 (<0.2, VEP).
aiva_evidence.PP4: Not applicable per GN125: PAH does not have a single genetic etiology.
aiva_evidence.BA1: Not met: highest gnomAD subpopulation AF with >=1,000 alleles is 0.1769% in gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes controls EAS (0.0557% in gnomAD v4.1 joint EAS per annotate_variant VEP), below the GN125 >1% threshold.
aiva_evidence.BS1: Met at Strong (-4 points): gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes controls EAS AF=0.001769 (0.1769%, AC=16, AN~9,045 >=1,000 alleles) per annotate_variant VEP, meeting the GN125 threshold of >=0.1% in the highest gnomAD controls subpopulation with >=1,000 alleles.
aiva_evidence.BS2: Not met: 0 homozygotes observed in gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes controls, v2.1.1 non-cancer, and v4.1 joint per annotate_variant VEP, and no healthy adult homozygotes reported in literature (GN125 requires >=1 homozygote).
aiva_evidence.BS3: Met at Supporting (-1 point): functional analysis of BMPR2 p.Arg873Gln in Girerd et al. 2015 (PMID:25429696, summarized in web search) showed no impairment of canonical BMPR2 signaling while alternative/non-canonical pathways were not excluded, meeting GN125 BS3_Supporting.
aiva_evidence.BS4: Not met: no evidence of lack of segregation in affected PAH family members was provided or identified in literature (GN125).
aiva_evidence.BP1: Not applicable per GN125: both loss-of-function and missense variants in BMPR2 cause PAH.
aiva_evidence.BP2: Not met: no evidence of co-occurrence in trans or in cis with an established pathogenic BMPR2 variant was provided or found in literature (GN125).
aiva_evidence.BP3: Not applicable: missense SNV, not an in-frame deletion or insertion in a repetitive region per annotate_variant VEP (GN125).
aiva_evidence.BP4: Not met: GN125 requires 2/3 of REVEL (<=0.29), AlphaMissense (<=0.169), and CADD (<=22.7); here REVEL=0.551, AlphaMissense=0.2661, and CADD=26.1 per annotate_variant VEP/myvariant meet 0/3 thresholds (and variant is missense, not a non-canonical splice variant).
aiva_evidence.BP5: Not met: no evidence of this variant occurring in a PAH case with an alternate molecular basis for disease was provided or found in literature (GN125).
aiva_evidence.BP7: Not applicable: missense variant (p.Arg873Gln), not a synonymous or intronic variant per annotate_variant VEP (GN125).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Pulmonary Hypertension VCEP specifications for BMPR2 Version 2.0 (GN125; PMID:40661831). Applied strength counts: 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, and 0 Supporting pathogenic criteria; 0 Stand-Alone, 1 Strong (BS1, -4 points), 0 Moderate, and 1 Supporting (BS3 applied at Supporting, -1 point) benign criteria. Total points = -5, which falls within the GN125 points_rules interval for Likely Benign (-6 to -2 points; Benign requires <=-7, VUS -1 to 5, Likely Pathogenic 6 to 9, Pathogenic >=10).

aiva_evidence.PM1: Not applicable per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): intronic +6 splice donor region variant rather than a missense substitution at a specific extracellular or kinase domain residue.
aiva_evidence.PM2: Met at Supporting (+1 point) per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): absent from gnomAD (no gnomAD record / AF=0 per both Ensembl VEP and MyVariant annotate_variant lookups), meeting GN125 threshold of <0.01% in gnomAD controls.

aiva_evidence.PM4: Not applicable per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): single-nucleotide intronic substitution rather than an in-frame indel or stop-loss variant.

aiva_evidence.PM6: Not applicable per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): confirmation of maternity and paternity is required.

aiva_evidence.PP3: Met at Supporting (+1 point) per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): SpliceAI predicts donor loss with DS_DL=0.758 (max_delta=0.758, DP_DL=-6 per annotate_variant VEP), exceeding the GN125 non-canonical splice threshold of SpliceAI >=0.2.
aiva_evidence.PP4: Not applicable per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): PAH does not have a single genetic etiology.
aiva_evidence.BA1: Not met per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant VEP and MyVariant (GN125 threshold >1%).
aiva_evidence.BS1: Not met per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant VEP and MyVariant (GN125 threshold >=0.1%).
aiva_evidence.BS2: Not met per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): absent from gnomAD and no homozygotes reported in healthy adults.

aiva_evidence.BP7: Not met per ClinGen BMPR2 VCEP (GN125): BP4 is not met because SpliceAI DS_DL=0.758 predicts donor loss and patient RNA data shows aberrant splicing.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Pulmonary Hypertension VCEP BMPR2 v2.0 specifications (GN125). Met criteria: 1 Strong (PS3_Strong, +4 points: patient LCL RT-PCR/sequencing demonstrating aberrant splicing p.G47_Q82del, G63_Q82del in PMID:16728714) and 2 Supporting (PM2_Supporting, +1 point: absent in gnomAD; PP3_Supporting, +1 point: SpliceAI DS_DL=0.758 >=0.2), with 0 benign criteria met. Under GN125 points_rules (Pathogenic >=10, Likely Pathogenic 6 to 9, Uncertain Significance -1 to 5, Likely Benign -6 to -2, Benign <=-7), the total score of 6 points meets Likely Pathogenic. Confidence is medium because only one unrelated FPAH family is published and full-text quantitative transcript/matched-unaffected control details from PMID:16728714 were not directly inspected.

aiva_evidence.PP3: Not met per GN040: non-coding 5' UTR variant without a REVEL missense score, and SpliceAI max_delta=0.007 (DS_DG=0.007, DS_AG=0, DS_AL=0, DS_DL=0 per VEP) predicts no splicing impact.

aiva_evidence.BS1: Not met per GN040 (gnomAD FAF >=0.025% threshold): variant is absent from gnomAD per VEP and MyVariant.

aiva_evidence.BP2: Not met per GN040: no evidence of occurrence in cis or trans with a pathogenic variant.
aiva_evidence.BP3: Not applicable per GN040 (no known benign repetitive areas in RASopathy genes; also not an in-frame coding indel).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen RASopathy VCEP RAF1 v2.3 specification (GN040). Variant 3:12705624:TCG:T (GRCh37; VEP canonical ENST00000251849.4:c.-341_-340del, input NM_002880.3:c.-339_-338AG[1]) is a 2-bp deletion in the RAF1 5' UTR overlapping promoter feature ENSR3_8D3FS with no predicted splicing impact (SpliceAI max_delta=0.007) and no literature reports. Applied strength counts: 0 Pathogenic Very Strong, 0 Pathogenic Strong, 0 Pathogenic Moderate, 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2); 0 Benign Stand Alone, 0 Benign Strong, 0 Benign Moderate, 0 Benign Supporting. Under GN040 combining rules, neither Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic (minimum 1 PM + 4 PP or 1 PS + 2 PP) nor Benign/Likely Benign (minimum 1 BS or 2 BP) thresholds are met, yielding VUS (leaning pathogenic) based on acmg_score=1 from PM2 at Supporting strength.

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Met at Very Strong per ClinGen Lysosomal Diseases VCEP IDUA v1.2 (GN091): NM_000203.5:c.1A>G (p.Met1?) is a start_lost initiation codon variant per annotate_variant (vep), and GN091 explicitly assigns PVS1 (Very Strong) to IDUA initiation codon variants because the next in-frame methionine is at Met133 (eliminating the signal peptide aa 1-27, UniProt:P35475) with 6 pathogenic variants upstream; LOF is an established mechanism of autosomal recessive MPS I (Verified Clinical Context; 275 PubTator papers; PMID:21394825, PMID:27146977, PMID:28752568; low gnomAD pLI=2.7e-21 and oe_lof_upper=1.16 per annotate_variant are expected for recessive disease).
aiva_evidence.PS1: Not met per GN091: c.1A>G (Atg/Gtg, start_lost) is an initiation codon variant evaluated under PVS1, not a missense substitution matching the same amino acid change at another nucleotide nor a splice region variant (SpliceAI max_delta=0.003 per annotate_variant).
aiva_evidence.PS2: Not met per GN091: no confirmed or unconfirmed de novo occurrence reported in the clinical context or literature.
aiva_evidence.PS3: Not met per GN091: no variant-specific in vitro expression study measuring alpha-L-iduronidase enzyme activity (<2% or <1% threshold) was identified for c.1A>G.
aiva_evidence.PS4: Not applicable per GN091: no case-control studies exist for autosomal recessive MPS I and affected proband observations are evaluated under PM3.
aiva_evidence.PM1: Not met per GN091: PM1 applies only to missense substitutions or in-frame deletions at 13 specified active-site/substrate-binding residues (Arg89, His91, Asn181, Glu182, His262, Lys264, Glu299, Asp301, Gly305, Trp306, Asp349, Arg363, Asn372), whereas c.1A>G alters the initiation codon (Met1).
aiva_evidence.PM2: Met at Supporting per GN091: gnomAD v4.1 joint AF=6.74e-7 (1/1,484,178 alleles, 0 homozygotes) and popmax AF=8.89e-7 (1/1,124,490 alleles, 0 homozygotes; gnomAD exomes NFE AF=9.47e-7, 0 in all other continental populations) per annotate_variant (vep), well below the GN091 threshold of <0.00025 (0.025%) in any continental population with >2,000 alleles.
aiva_evidence.PM3: Met at Moderate per GN091 (ClinGen SVI PM3 points system): in autosomal recessive MPS I (Verified Clinical Context), c.1A>G was identified in the homozygous state in two unrelated affected probands, a severe MPS I patient in a UK cohort (PMID:28752568 per web_search and search_biomedical_literature) and an MPS I patient in an Indian cohort (PMID:27146977 per web_search and annotate_variant), totaling 1.0 point (0.5 + 0.5).
aiva_evidence.PM4: Not met per GN091: PM4 applies to stop-loss variants and in-frame deletions/insertions (<1 exon), whereas c.1A>G is a start_lost initiation codon variant per annotate_variant (vep).
aiva_evidence.PM5: Not met per GN091: PM5 applies to missense or stop-loss variants at a residue with another pathogenic/likely pathogenic change, whereas c.1A>G is an initiation codon (start_lost) variant evaluated under PVS1.
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not applicable per GN091: unconfirmed de novo variants are assessed under PS2_Moderate, and no de novo data exist for c.1A>G.
aiva_evidence.PP1: Not met per GN091: no multi-affected family co-segregation data for c.1A>G were found in the clinical context or literature.
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not applicable per GN091: both benign and pathogenic missense variants occur in IDUA (and c.1A>G is start_lost; IDUA mis_z=-1.50, oe_mis_upper=1.17 per annotate_variant gnomad_constraint).
aiva_evidence.PP3: Not met per GN091: PP3 applies to missense variants (REVEL>=0.644), in-frame indels, or non-canonical splice variants (SpliceAI>0.2); c.1A>G is a start_lost variant with REVEL=0.486 and SpliceAI max_delta=0.003 per annotate_variant (vep).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Monogenic Diabetes Expert Panel Specifications for GCK Version 3.1 (GN086) for monogenic diabetes (semidominant inheritance). Met pathogenic criteria strengths: 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 1 Moderate (PM1: ATP-binding site Gly410-His416), and 4 Supporting (PM2: gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF=8.50e-7/FAF=0 <=3e-6; PS3: thermolability RSI=0 <=0.5 with RAI=0.62; PP2: missense in GCK with mis_z=3.35; PP3: REVEL=0.928 >=0.70); 0 benign criteria met. Per GN086 combining rules, 1 Pathogenic Moderate + >=4 Pathogenic Supporting fires Likely Pathogenic (acmg_score=6). PS4, PP1, and PP4 were not applied because primary proband counts, pedigree meiosis counts, and quantitative HbA1c/FPG values were not directly verifiable from the provided clinical context or retrieved primary literature.

Under GN005 v2.0 combining rules, 2 Supporting pathogenic criteria do not satisfy any Pathogenic or Likely Pathogenic combining rule (minimum Likely Pathogenic requires PVS1+PM2_Supporting, 1 VS+1 M/P, 1 S+1-2 M, 1 S+>=2 P, >=3 M, 2 M+>=2 P, or 1 M+>=4 P), and no Benign or Likely Benign rule is met. aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Phenylketonuria Expert Panel PAH VCEP Version 2.1 specifications (GN006) for autosomal recessive phenylketonuria. Applied pathogenic criteria strengths: 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 1 Moderate (PP4_Moderate), and 3 Supporting (PM2_Supporting, PM3_Supporting, PP3); benign criteria: 0 Stand Alone, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 0 Supporting (acmg_score = 5). Under the PAH VCEP GN006 combining rules, Likely Pathogenic requires at least 1 Pathogenic Moderate + >=4 Pathogenic Supporting (or >=2 Pathogenic Moderate + >=2 Pathogenic Supporting). Because 1 Moderate + 3 Supporting falls one supporting criterion short of Likely Pathogenic and no benign criteria are met, the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic). Confirmed in trans phasing, additional independent genotyped PKU probands, or an RNA splicing assay demonstrating aberrant splicing would upgrade this variant.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Phenylketonuria Expert Panel PAH v2.1 specifications (GN006, PMID:30311390), which supersede generic ACMG/AMP rules. Note that GRCh37 coordinates 12:103246629:ATG:A verify on the reference genome as ENST00000553106.1:c.804_805del (p.Ile269GlnfsTer13), whereas the input HGVS string NM_000277.2:c.806delT is discordant by 1-2 nt; both represent frameshift deletions at codon 269 upstream of c.1285 with no population or literature records. Met criteria by applied strength: 1 Pathogenic Very Strong (PVS1), 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting), and 0 Benign criteria (ACMG summary score = +9). Applying GN006 combining_rules verbatim (which require 1 PVS + 1 PM for Likely Pathogenic or 1 PVS + >=2 PP for Pathogenic, and do not include a 1 PVS + 1 PP -> Likely Pathogenic rule), no Pathogenic, Likely Pathogenic, Benign, or Likely Benign combining rule fires. aiva_rationale: Because NM_001354304.2:c.510-735_912+434del (GRCh37 chr12:103245031-103249845) is a 4,815 bp (>1 kb) intragenic multi-exon deletion, it is governed by the ACMG/ClinGen Technical Standards for the Interpretation and Reporting of Constitutional Copy-Number Variants (Riggs et al., 2020; Genet Med 22:245-257; PMID:31690835), Copy-Number Loss Scoring Metric (Table 1 and Supplemental Material 1). Interval size: 4,815 bp. Gene count: 1 protein-coding RefSeq gene (PAH, HGNC:8582; both breakpoints intronic within PAH). ClinGen Dosage Sensitivity Map rating for PAH (ISCA-9235 / CCID:007610): Haploinsufficiency (HI) Score = 30 (Gene Associated with Autosomal Recessive Phenotype: homozygous LOF mutations cause phenylketonuria and non-PKU HPA), Triplosensitivity (TS) Score = 0 (No Evidence). Section-by-section CNV Loss Scoring Metric evaluation: Section 1A (contains protein-coding exons 6-8 of MANE Select NM_000277.3 / exons 7-9 of NM_001354304.2) = 0.00 points (continue evaluation); Section 2E (both breakpoints within the same gene; evaluated per ClinGen SVI PVS1 specifications PMID:30192042 and ClinGen PAH VCEP v2.1 GN006) = +0.90 points for PVS1 Very Strong because the 403 bp coding deletion (c.510_912) disrupts the reading frame at codon 170 with a premature stop codon at WT c.1021 (well upstream of the GN006 NMD cutoff at c.1285 and the last exon-exon junction at c.1315), is predicted to undergo NMD, and affects an established autosomal recessive LOF disease gene; Section 2F/2G (no established benign CNV overlap) = 0.00 points; Section 2H (HI predictors) = not applied per Riggs et al. 2020 when Section 2E applies; Section 3A (0-24 genes; 1 gene) = 0.00 points; Section 4 (no published cases, segregations, case-control studies, or common population CNV overlap identified) = 0.00 points; Section 5F (inheritance unavailable/uninformative, no patient-level biochemical confirmation or second trans allele provided) = 0.00 points. Total CNV score = 0.90 points, which meets the ACMG/ClinGen Riggs et al. (2020) threshold for Likely Pathogenic (0.90 to 0.98; Pathogenic >=0.99; VUS -0.89 to 0.89). Schema ACMG summary tally: 1 Very Strong criterion (PVS1) = acmg_score 8. Clinical reporting note per Riggs et al. (2020): because phenylketonuria is autosomal recessive, a single heterozygous copy of this Likely Pathogenic deletion indicates carrier status and is not diagnostic without a second pathogenic/likely pathogenic PAH variant in trans.

aiva_rationale: Because NM_001354304.2:c.442-4403_509+883del (GRCh37 chr12:103259491-103264844) is an intragenic copy-number deletion spanning 5,354 bp (>1 kb), it is governed by the ACMG/ClinGen Technical Standards for the Interpretation and Reporting of Constitutional Copy-Number Variants (Riggs et al., 2020, Genet Med 22:245-257, PMID:31690835; Erratum PMID:33731880; Copy Number Loss Scoring Rubric) rather than the standalone ACMG/AMP 2015 sequence-variant framework. Genomic content and dosage curation: the 5,354 bp interval involves 1 protein-coding gene, PAH (HGNC:8582, ENSG00000171759), with both breakpoints located in introns 4 and 5, completely removing exon 5 (c.442_509, 68 bp). Per the ClinGen Dosage Sensitivity Map (ISCA-9235, CCID:007610), PAH has a Haploinsufficiency (HI) score of 30 (Gene Associated with Autosomal Recessive Phenotype: phenylketonuria, MONDO:0009861, via homozygous loss of function) and a Triplosensitivity (TS) score of 0 (No Evidence for Triplosensitivity); gnomAD constraint (pLI=0, LOEUF=1.27) reflects recessive inheritance. Scoring under Riggs et al. (2020) Table 1 (Copy Number Loss): Section 1A = 0 points (contains protein-coding sequence; directs intragenic losses to Section 2E); Section 2E = +0.90 points, which explicitly invokes ClinGen SVI PVS1 guidance (Abou Tayoun et al., 2018, PMID:30192042) and here ClinGen PAH VCEP Specifications v2.1 (GN006), under which a single-exon out-of-frame deletion (68 bp, 68 mod 3 = 2) upstream of c.1285 predicted to undergo NMD in an established LOF gene meets PVS1 at Very Strong (+0.90, max for 2E); Sections 2F-2H = 0 points (no benign CNV overlap; HI predictors not elevated); Section 3A = 0 points (1 protein-coding gene); Section 4 = 0 points (gene-level LOF already credited in Section 2E; although other PAH exon 5 deletions with different or unmapped breakpoints are reported in PKU patients, e.g., PMID:40473815, PMID:37509538, PMC6081236, no variant-specific proband, segregation, de novo, or case-control data exist for c.442-4403_509+883del); Section 5F = 0 points (inheritance, zygosity, presence of a second pathogenic allele in trans, and biochemical confirmation of persistent plasma Phe >120 umol/L are unavailable). Total Riggs et al. (2020) CNV score = +0.90 points, which falls within the Likely Pathogenic threshold (0.90 to 0.98; Pathogenic requires >=0.99). Summary ACMG strength tally for the single invoked criterion PVS1 (Very Strong) is acmg_score = 8. Because PAH-related phenylketonuria is autosomal recessive, clinical significance for an individual requires confirmation of a second pathogenic allele in trans or homozygosity.

aiva_rationale: Because NM_001354304.2:c.442-1377_509+226del (GRCh37 chr12:103260151_103261821del; VEP ENST00000553106.1:c.442-1380_509+223del) is a 1,671 bp (>1 kb) copy-number loss, it is governed by the ACMG/ClinGen Technical Standards for the Interpretation and Reporting of Constitutional Copy-Number Variants (Riggs et al. 2020, PMID:31690835; corrected 2021, PMID:33731880). Interval size: 1,671 bp; gene count: 1 protein-coding gene (PAH, HGNC:8582, ENSG00000171759), with both breakpoints intronic (intron 4 to intron 5) deleting all of coding exon 5 (c.442_509, 68 bp). ClinGen Dosage Sensitivity Map (GRCh37, evaluated 2014-08-28) rates PAH as Haploinsufficiency Score = 30 (Gene associated with autosomal recessive phenotype, MONDO:0009861 phenylketonuria) and Triplosensitivity Score = 0 (No evidence available); low gnomAD LOF constraint (pLI=7.06e-23, LOEUF=1.27 per annotate_variant) is expected for an autosomal recessive disorder and does not weaken LOF pathogenicity. Scoring under the Riggs et al. 2020 Copy-Number Loss metric: Section 1A (contains protein-coding sequence, PAH exon 5) = 0.00 points; Section 2E (both breakpoints within the same gene, intragenic CNV, directed to ClinGen SVI PVS1 specifications per Abou Tayoun et al. 2018 PMID:30192042, ClinGen PAH VCEP GN006 v2.1, and AR intragenic CNV practice per Brandt et al. 2020 PMID:31534211 and Lemire et al. 2023 PMID:37873196) = +0.90 points because exon 5 deletion removes 68 coding nucleotides (frameshift, 68 mod 3 = 2) upstream of the PAH VCEP c.1285 NMD cutoff, predicted to undergo NMD (PVS1 Very Strong; 1 Very Strong criterion, acmg_score = 8); Section 3A (0-24 genes; 1 gene) = 0.00 points; Section 4 (no published case reports with confirmed c.442-1377_509+226del breakpoints, as distinct PAH exon 5 deletions such as EX5del4232ins268 and EX5del955 in PMID:30258912 have different breakpoints and MLPA-only exon 5 deletions in PMID:40473815 lack breakpoint confirmation; no common benign CNV overlap in 4O) = 0.00 points; Section 5 (no proband inheritance/segregation data) = 0.00 points. Total Riggs et al. 2020 score = +0.90 points, meeting the Likely Pathogenic threshold (0.90 to 0.98 points).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Monogenic Diabetes VCEP HNF1A Version 3.1 specifications (GN017). Met criteria counts: 0 Pathogenic Very Strong, 0 Pathogenic Strong, 0 Pathogenic Moderate, 0 Pathogenic Supporting, 0 Benign Stand Alone, 1 Benign Strong (BS1), and 0 Benign Supporting (ACMG score = -4). Under GN017 combining rules, Benign requires >=2 Benign Strong or 1 Benign Stand Alone, and Likely Benign requires 1 Benign Strong + 1 Benign Supporting or >=2 Benign Supporting; neither threshold is met because gnomAD v4.1 Grpmax FAF95 (4.38e-5) satisfies BS1 (>=3.3e-5) without reaching BA1 (>=1.0e-4) and REVEL (0.280) is indeterminate under GN017 (>0.15 for BP4, <0.70 for PP3). With only 1 Benign Strong criterion and no pathogenic evidence, the variant classifies as VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Under the ClinGen Rett and Angelman-like Disorders VCEP FOXG1 Version 6.0 specifications (GN035), the met criteria counts are 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting, +1) and 1 Benign Supporting (BP3, -1), giving an ACMG score of 0. Neither Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic combining rules (minimum 1 PVS + 1 PM, 1 PS + 1 PM, 1 PS + >=2 PP, >=3 PM, 2 PM + >=2 PP, or 1 PM + >=4 PP) nor Benign/Likely Benign combining rules (minimum 1 BA1, >=1 BS, or >=2 BP) are reached, resulting in a Variant of Uncertain Significance (VUS). Note that while the submitted HGVS (NM_005249.4:c.209_232del24, 24 bp) differs by 3 bp from the GRCh37 VCF alleles (14:29236694:AGCAGCAGCAGCCGCCGCCGCC:A, 21 bp, VEP ENST00000382535.3:c.212_232del / p.Gln71_Pro77del), both are in-frame deletions strictly contained within the poly-Gln (p.Gln70-p.Gln73) and poly-Pro (p.Pro74-p.Pro80) repetitive region (p.58-p.86), yielding identical VCEP criterion assignments. The variant leans benign (VUS leaning benign) because the sole pathogenic support is weak absence from gnomAD (PM2_Supporting), with no case, segregation, functional, domain, or computational evidence of pathogenicity, whereas it deletes residues solely within a VCEP-designated repetitive region without known function (BP3) explicitly excluded from PM4 and shows no predicted splicing impact (SpliceAI max_delta=0.001).

aiva_rationale: No ClinGen VCEP specification was returned for DICER1 by clingen_vcep, so generic ACMG/AMP 2015 criteria with ClinGen SVI calibrated thresholds were applied. Strength counts: Pathogenic = 0 VS, 0 S, 0 M, 0 P; Benign = 0 BA1, 0 BS, 1 BM (BP4 applied at Moderate strength based on REVEL=0.128 <= 0.183 and SpliceAI max_delta=0.001 <= 0.1), 0 BP; acmg_score = -2. Under the ClinGen SVI adaptation of ACMG/AMP 2015 Likely Benign combining rule (ii) (Pejaver et al. 2022, PMC9748256), 1 Benign Moderate criterion (BP4_Moderate, equivalent in Bayesian weight to 2 BP / -2 points) with no conflicting pathogenic evidence meets Likely Benign.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen SCID VCEP FOXN1 v2.3 specifications (GN113) for T-cell immunodeficiency, congenital alopecia, and nail dystrophy (semidominant inheritance). Met pathogenic criteria: 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 3 Moderate (PS3_Moderate, PM1, PP3_Moderate), and 2 Supporting (PM2_Supporting, PP4_Supporting); met benign criteria: 0 (ACMG score = 8). Under GN113 combining rules, 3 Pathogenic Moderate + 2 Pathogenic Supporting satisfies the Likely Pathogenic rules (>=3 Pathogenic Moderate; and 2 Pathogenic Moderate + >=2 Pathogenic Supporting) without meeting any Pathogenic rule (which requires >=1 Very Strong or >=1 Strong criterion).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1 VCEP specifications v1.2 (GN092), NM_007294.4:c.3082C>T (p.Arg1028Cys) meets 1 Benign Very Strong (BP5_VeryStrong: combined multifactorial LR=0.0009 <=0.00285), 2 Benign Strong (BP1_Strong: missense outside clinically important functional domains with SpliceAI=0.001 <=0.1; BS3: normal protein function in calibrated HRR assay), and 1 Benign Supporting (BS2_Supporting: homozygous adult without Fanconi Anemia phenotype), with 0 Pathogenic criteria met (acmg_score=-17). This exceeds the Benign combining rule (>=2 Benign Strong criteria, and well below the <=-7 Bayesian point threshold for Benign) with no conflicting pathogenic evidence, classifying the variant as Benign for BRCA1-related cancer predisposition.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1 and BRCA2 VCEP Specifications for BRCA1 Version 1.2 (GN092), which governs this 510-bp intragenic single-exon deletion (<1 kb; NM_007294.4:c.5333-36_5406+400del; GRCh37 chr17:41200741-41201250del, removing entire RefSeq exon 21 / legacy exon 22, c.5333_5406, 74 bp out-of-frame, encoding p.1778-1802 in the BRCT repeat domain aa 1650-1857). Applied evidence strength counts: 1 Pathogenic Very Strong (PVS1 = 8 pts, explicitly assigned to DEL E21(22) in GN092 Specifications Table 4) + 1 Pathogenic Strong (PM5 applied as PM5_Strong (PTC) = 4 pts, explicitly assigned to PVS1-eligible out-of-frame large deletions affecting BRCA1 exon 21(22) per GN092 Table 4 and Appendix D), with 0 Moderate, 0 Supporting, and 0 Benign criteria met (PM2 is disallowed for deletions under GN092). Under GN092 Table 3 adapted ACMG/AMP combining rules, 1 Very Strong + >=1 Strong fires the Pathogenic rule (consistent with 12 points >=10 on the Tavtigian 2020 point scale referenced in GN092 and with the generic ACMG/AMP Pathogenic rule). Clinical literature independently identifies this exact 510-bp Alu-mediated BRCA1 exon 22 deletion as a recurrent Dutch founder mutation in hereditary breast/ovarian cancer families (PMID:9354803, PMID:15846789, PMID:34022715).

aiva_rationale: Applied ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1 VCEP v1.2 specifications (GN092). Strength counts: 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2) and 1 Benign Supporting (BP4); 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate pathogenic; 0 Stand Alone, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate benign; acmg_score = 0 (+1 - 1). Because GN092 combining_rules specifies only BA1 -> Benign, generic ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply: neither pathogenic/likely pathogenic nor benign/likely benign thresholds are reached, resulting in VUS. Classification leans benign (VUS (leaning benign)) because for a non-coding intronic deletion outside canonical +/-1,2 splice sites, splicing disruption is the primary plausible pathogenic mechanism and SpliceAI predicts negligible splicing impact (max_delta=0.013 <= 0.1), whereas PM2 reflects only rarity in population databases. Note: VEP maps the GRCh37 genomic variant 17:41267807:AGG:A to ENST00000471181.2:c.81-13_81-12del (2-bp deletion) while the input HGVS specifies NM_007294.4:c.81-11del; both lie within the intron 2 polypyrimidine tract (-20 to -3), outside +/-1,2 and inside the -20 to -1 acceptor motif (so BP4 applies and BP7_Supporting does not under GN092).

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP v2.1 (GN011), which retains standard ACMG/AMP 2015 pathogenic/benign combining rules (plus ClinGen SVI 2020 1 VS + 1 P for Likely Pathogenic), the variant meets 0 Very Strong, 1 Strong (PVS1_Strong), 0 Moderate, and 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting) pathogenic criteria, and 0 benign criteria (acmg_score = 5). Because 1 Strong + 1 Supporting does not reach the Likely Pathogenic threshold (which requires 1 Strong + 1-2 Moderate or 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting), the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic). Note on input notation: GRCh37 coordinates 17:42451819:CGG:C correspond to ENST00000262407.5:c.2961_2962del (p.Arg988GlyfsTer47) per VEP, whereas the supplied HGVS NM_000419.5:c.2965del is a 1-bp deletion at codon 989 (p.Ala989Profs* reading through into the 3' UTR); both are exon 29 frameshifts absent from gnomAD that escape NMD and disrupt the VCEP-specified critical ITGA2B transmembrane domain (aa 994-1019), yielding identical criteria (PVS1_Strong + PM2_Supporting) and classification.

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP v2.1 (GN011), which provides no custom combining_rules or points_rules, standard ACMG/AMP 2015 and ClinGen SVI 2020 combining rules apply. Met criteria counts by applied strength are 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, and 2 Supporting pathogenic criteria (PM2 at Supporting and PP3 at Supporting) and 0 benign criteria (0 BA1, 0 BS, 0 BM, 0 BP), yielding acmg_score=2. Two Supporting pathogenic criteria do not meet the threshold for Likely Pathogenic or Pathogenic and no benign rules fire, so the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic). Although SpliceAI strongly predicts loss of the canonical splice donor site (DS_DL=0.905) and the variant is ultra-rare in gnomAD, it is a non-canonical +5 intronic variant without retrieved RNA/functional splicing studies or documented proband clinical/allelic data in available literature.

aiva_rationale: Applied ClinGen Lysosomal Diseases VCEP specifications for GAA (GN010 v2.0) verbatim for individual criteria; because GN010 provides no custom combining_rules or points_rules, ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply. Met pathogenic criteria: 1 Very Strong (PVS1: frameshift p.Ala14GlyfsTer18 introducing a premature stop at codon 31, before codon 916) and 1 Moderate (PM2: absent in gnomAD, MAF <0.001 per GN010). Met benign criteria: 0 (BA1=0, BS=0, BM=0, BP=0). Under ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules, 1 Very Strong + 1 Moderate meets Likely Pathogenic (does not reach Pathogenic, which requires 1 VS + >=1 S or >=2 M or 1 M + 1 P or >=2 P). Total acmg_score = 8 (PVS1_VS) + 2 (PM2_M) = 10.

aiva_rationale: Applied strength counts under ClinGen Lysosomal Storage Disorders VCEP specifications (GN010 v2.0): Pathogenic = 1 Very Strong (PVS1: frameshift PTC at codon 328 before codon 916 for autosomal recessive GSD II; note genomic coordinates 17:78081674 CTG>C map to ENST00000302262.3:c.935_936del p.Leu312ProfsTer17 while input HGVS states NM_000152.5:c.934del, both frameshifts at codon 312), 0 Strong, 1 Moderate (PM2: absent from gnomAD, AF=0 < 0.001 per GN010 v2.0), 0 Supporting; Benign = 0 BA1, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 0 Supporting. aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Lysosomal Diseases VCEP specifications for GAA (GN010 v2.0), which returned no custom combining_rules/points_rules, so generic ACMG/AMP combining rules were applied to VCEP-specified strengths. Strength counts: 1 Very Strong (PVS1) and 1 Moderate (PM2), with 0 Strong, 0 Supporting, and 0 Benign criteria met (acmg_score=10). Combining rule fired: 1 Very Strong + 1 Moderate -> Likely Pathogenic (also Likely Pathogenic even if PM2 were Supporting). Note: input HGVS NM_000152.5:c.1153del corresponds to GRCh37 17-78082364-CC-C (p.Arg385AlafsTer7, PTC at codon 391), whereas the provided GRCh37 coordinates 17:78082365 CGC>C map to c.1154_1155del (p.Arg385ProfsTer120, PTC at codon 504); both passed VEP without reference mismatch, are absent from gnomAD, create a PTC before codon 916, and yield identical criteria (PVS1, PM2) and classification (Likely Pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Applied strength counts per ClinGen Lysosomal Diseases VCEP v2.0 (GN010): 1 Very Strong (PVS1) and 1 Moderate (PM2), with 0 Strong, 0 Supporting, and 0 Benign criteria (acmg_score=10). Because GN010 does not define custom combining rules in its specification payload, standard ACMG/AMP combining rules apply: 1 Very Strong + 1 Moderate fires the Likely Pathogenic rule (note that even under generic ClinGen SVI 2020 PM2 Supporting strength, 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting also yields Likely Pathogenic). Note on input notation: the provided HGVS (NM_000152.5:c.1952del, corresponding to GRCh37 17-78086737-GG-G, p.Gly651AlafsTer45, PTC at codon 695) and VCF coordinates (17:78086738 GCA>G, corresponding to ENST00000302262.3:c.1953_1954del, p.Asn652HisfsTer84, PTC at codon 735) differ by 1-2 nucleotides at the same locus, but both are valid on GRCh37, absent from gnomAD and published literature, introduce premature stop codons well upstream of codon 916, and independently meet PVS1 (Very Strong) and PM2 (Moderate) for a classification of Likely Pathogenic.

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Not met per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010: c.1076-22T>G is a non-canonical intronic variant (not +/-1,2 splice site, nonsense, frameshift, or exon deletion); splicing impact is evaluated under PS3 and PP3.
aiva_evidence.PS1: Not applicable per GN010: intronic splice variant, not a missense substitution producing the same amino acid change as an established pathogenic variant.
aiva_evidence.PS2: Not applicable per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010: de novo occurrence is not a recognized causal criterion for autosomal recessive GAA/Pompe disease.
aiva_evidence.PS3: Met (applied at Moderate per GN010): three independent RT-PCR/cDNA cloning studies (PMID:9259196, PMID:10737124, PMID:22676651) demonstrate that c.1076-22T>G activates an intron 6 cryptic acceptor site, causing aberrant in-frame splicing (insertion of 21 intronic bp / 7 aa and deletion of 25 or 40 aa of exon 6); applied at Moderate because it is an in-frame cryptic splice defect associated with juvenile/late-onset disease without demonstrated complete absence of normal transcripts.
aiva_evidence.PS4: Not applicable per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010: no case-control studies exist for recessive Pompe disease; case counts are addressed under PM3.
aiva_evidence.PM1: Not met per GN010: intronic variant affecting exon 6 residues 319-358 does not alter any of the VCEP-specified critical active-site/substrate-binding residues (D282, W376, D404, L405, I441, W481, W516, D518, M519, R600, W613, D616, W618, F649, L650, H674).
aiva_evidence.PM2: Met (applied at Supporting per GN010 v2.0 / PMID:37907381): gnomAD exomes overall AF=6.845e-06, highest population AF=1.907e-05 (FIN) and 8.094e-06 (NFE), with AF=0 in AFR, AMR, ASJ, EAS, MID, and SAS per annotate_variant (rs762260678), well below the GN010 threshold of <0.001 (<0.1%).
aiva_evidence.PM3: Met (applied at Strong per GN010 points system, >=2.0 points): confirmed in trans with established pathogenic variants in two unrelated Pompe disease probands: (1) confirmed in trans by parental study with p.Arg854Ter in juvenile-onset Pompe disease (PMID:9259196, 1.0 pt), and (2) confirmed in trans by allele-specific transcript cloning with [c.1426C>A; c.1437+1G>A] (canonical +1 splice variant with zero normal splice products) in non-classic Pompe disease (PMID:22676651, 1.0 pt); further corroborated by additional c.1076-22T>G/null Pompe patients (PMID:34405923, PMID:27408821).
aiva_evidence.PM4: Not met per GN010: non-canonical intronic variant rather than a coding in-frame indel or stop-loss variant; splicing consequence is captured under PS3.
aiva_evidence.PM5: Not applicable per GN010: intronic splice variant, not a missense substitution at an amino acid residue with a previously established pathogenic missense variant.
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not applicable per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010: de novo criteria are not used for autosomal recessive GAA/Pompe disease.
aiva_evidence.PP1: Not applicable per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010: GAA is the sole gene for Pompe disease, so family co-segregation does not distinguish pathogenic variants from linked benign variants.
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not applicable per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010 (both benign and pathogenic missense variants occur in GAA; variant is intronic and gnomad_constraint shows mis_z=-0.53, oe_mis_upper=1.08).
aiva_evidence.PP3: Met (applied at Supporting per GN010): SpliceAI predicts strong cryptic splice acceptor gain (DS_AG=0.969) and native acceptor loss (DS_AL=0.563), max_delta=0.969 per annotate_variant, exceeding the GN010 threshold (>0.5); GN010 permits PP3 alongside PS3 for non-canonical splice variants and marks PP3_Moderate not applicable.
aiva_evidence.PP4: Met (applied at Moderate per GN010 points system, 2 points): Patient 17 in PMID:22676651 with clinically diagnosed Pompe disease (limb-girdle weakness onset age 9, wheelchair aged 33) had documented deficient GAA enzyme activity (2.8 in the affected non-classic Pompe range) without pseudodeficiency alleles (further supported by biochemically confirmed Pompe patients in PMID:9259196 and PMID:10737124).
aiva_evidence.BA1: Not met per GN010: highest gnomAD population AF is 1.907e-05 (FIN) and 8.094e-06 (NFE) per annotate_variant, far below the GN010 stand-alone benign cutoff of >0.01 (>1%).
aiva_evidence.BS1: Not met per GN010: highest gnomAD population AF is 1.907e-05 (FIN) and 8.094e-06 (NFE) per annotate_variant, far below the GN010 cutoff of >0.005 (>0.5%).
aiva_evidence.BS2: Not met per GN010: no homozygous individual of any age with documented normal GAA activity is reported; individual 11 in PMID:33162552 carried c.1076-22T>G with c.271G>A and c.-32-13T>G (not homozygous) and had subnormal GAA activity (5.7 and 33.3 vs normal >40-250 and >45-180).
aiva_evidence.BS3: Not met per GN010: functional RT-PCR/cDNA cloning studies (PMID:9259196, PMID:10737124, PMID:22676651) demonstrate aberrant splicing rather than normal GAA activity/splicing.
aiva_evidence.BS4: Not applicable per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010.
aiva_evidence.BP1: Not applicable per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010: all variant types cause Pompe disease and this variant is intronic.
aiva_evidence.BP2: Not met per GN010: not confirmed in cis with a pathogenic GAA variant (phase was unconfirmed in individual 11 of PMID:33162552 carrying c.271G>A, c.-32-13T>G, and c.1076-22T>G).
aiva_evidence.BP3: Not applicable per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010: no repetitive regions without known function are defined in GAA and this variant is intronic.
aiva_evidence.BP4: Not met per GN010: SpliceAI max_delta=0.969 (DS_AG=0.969, DS_AL=0.563) per annotate_variant, far above the GN010 benign cutoff (<0.2) and predicting cryptic acceptor creation.
aiva_evidence.BP5: Not applicable per ClinGen LSD VCEP GN010: there is no known alternate molecular basis for GAA deficiency other than variants in GAA.
aiva_evidence.BP7: Not applicable per GN010: intronic variant (not synonymous) with strong predicted splice impact (SpliceAI DS_AG=0.969) per annotate_variant.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Lysosomal Storage Disorders VCEP GAA Specifications Version 2.0 (GN010, combining per Richards et al. 2015). Pathogenic evidence counts by applied strength: 0 Very Strong, 1 Strong (PM3_Strong), 2 Moderate (PS3_Moderate, PP4_Moderate), 2 Supporting (PM2_Supporting, PP3); Benign evidence counts: 0 across all strengths. Meets Pathogenic combining rule (c): 1 Strong + 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting (acmg_score=10).

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Met at Very Strong per ClinGen LD VCEP GN010: frameshift deletion in canonical GAA transcript (17:78092460:CGT:C; ENST00000302262.3:c.2657_2658del / NM_000152.5:c.2655_2656del; p.Val886GlufsTer2 per annotate_variant VEP; 952 aa per UniProt:P10253) creating a premature stop codon at codon 887 before codon 916 in an established LOF gene for autosomal recessive glycogen storage disease II (GN010, PMID:37907381, PMID:39482698; gnomAD pLI=1.72e-25 and LOEUF=1.01 per gnomad_constraint do not weaken PVS1 for a recessive disorder).
aiva_evidence.PS1: Not applicable per GN010: applies to same amino acid change at a different nucleotide (missense), whereas this is a frameshift deletion.
aiva_evidence.PS2: Not applicable per GN010: marked Not Applicable for the GAA VCEP because de novo occurrence is not a recognized causal mechanism for Pompe disease, and no de novo data are provided.
aiva_evidence.PS3: Not met per GN010: no in vitro GAA expression assay (<30% WT activity) or RNA/RT-PCR functional study was found for this variant in PubTator3/PubMed searches.
aiva_evidence.PS4: Not applicable per GN010: marked Not Applicable for the GAA VCEP (no case-control studies for autosomal recessive Pompe disease; case observations are assessed under PM3).
aiva_evidence.PM1: Not applicable per GN010: applies only to missense substitutions or in-frame deletions of 16 specified active-site/substrate-binding residues (D282-H674), whereas this is a frameshift at Val886.
aiva_evidence.PM2: Met at Moderate per ClinGen LD VCEP GN010 verbatim (MAF <0.001 in all continental gnomAD populations with >2000 alleles): absent from gnomAD across successful annotate_variant VEP (GRCh37 17:78092460:CGT:C, no colocated gnomAD record) and MyVariant lookups (notfound), and reported absent from ExAC/gnomAD in PMID:31342611 (note: PMID:37907381 and ClinGen SVI 2020 apply PM2 at Supporting; either strength with PVS1 yields Likely Pathogenic).
aiva_evidence.PM3: Not met per GN010: although listed as a novel variant in Group C late-onset Pompe Registry patient(s) (PMID:31342611) and the Pompe variant database (PMID:33560568), neither source nor the clinical context reports a second pathogenic variant in trans or homozygosity (absent from homozygous Table 6 of PMID:31342611).
aiva_evidence.PM4: Not applicable per GN010: applies to in-frame indels or stop-loss variants, whereas this is an out-of-frame 2-bp frameshift deletion.
aiva_evidence.PM5: Not applicable per GN010: applies to missense variants at a residue with a previously established pathogenic/likely pathogenic missense change, whereas this is a frameshift deletion.
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not applicable per GN010: marked Not Applicable for the GAA VCEP (see PS2).
aiva_evidence.PP1: Not applicable per GN010: marked Not Applicable for the GAA VCEP because single-gene autosomal recessive segregation cannot exclude linkage disequilibrium, and no segregation data are provided.
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not applicable per GN010: marked Not Applicable for the GAA VCEP because both benign and pathogenic missense variants occur in GAA (gnomad_constraint mis_z=-0.53, oe_mis_upper=1.08), and this is a frameshift variant.
aiva_evidence.PP3: Not met per GN010: applies to missense variants (REVEL >0.7), in-frame indels, or variants with predicted splicing impact (SpliceAI >0.5); this is a frameshift variant with SpliceAI max_delta=0.014 per annotate_variant VEP.
aiva_evidence.PP4: Not met per GN010 and PMID:37907381: requires patient-level diagnostic evidence such as documented deficient GAA enzyme activity (with pseudodeficiency excluded) or specific clinical/biochemical features; neither the clinical context nor the Group C registry listing in PMID:31342611 reports individual GAA activity or clinical workup.
aiva_evidence.BA1: Not met per GN010 (threshold MAF >0.01 in any continental gnomAD population with >2000 alleles): variant is absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant VEP and MyVariant.
aiva_evidence.BS1: Not met per GN010 (threshold MAF >0.005 in any continental gnomAD population with >2000 alleles): variant is absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant VEP and MyVariant.
aiva_evidence.BS2: Not met per GN010: no observation in a homozygous (or compound heterozygous) healthy individual with documented normal GAA enzyme activity.
aiva_evidence.BS3: Not met per GN010: no functional assay showing >50% normal GAA activity (or >30% with normal synthesis and processing) exists for this variant.
aiva_evidence.BS4: Not applicable per GN010: marked Not Applicable for the GAA VCEP.
aiva_evidence.BP1: Not applicable per GN010: marked Not Applicable for the GAA VCEP (all variant types cause Pompe disease), and this is a frameshift variant rather than missense.
aiva_evidence.BP2: Not met per GN010: no observation in cis with a known pathogenic GAA variant is reported.
aiva_evidence.BP3: Not applicable per GN010: marked Not Applicable for the GAA VCEP (no repetitive regions without known function in GAA), and this is an out-of-frame deletion.
aiva_evidence.BP4: Not applicable per GN010: applies to missense (REVEL <0.5), in-frame indels, or splicing-only variants (SpliceAI <0.2); although SpliceAI max_delta=0.014 per annotate_variant VEP indicates no splicing effect, this coding frameshift variant causes premature termination.
aiva_evidence.BP5: Not applicable per GN010: marked Not Applicable for the GAA VCEP (no known alternate molecular basis for GAA deficiency, and incidental carrier status is possible).

aiva_rationale: Applied ClinGen Lysosomal Storage Disorders VCEP specifications for GAA (GN010 v2.0), which supersede generic criterion definitions and thresholds; as GN010 provides no custom combining_rules or points_rules, standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules were applied via python_repl. Met criteria counts by applied strength: 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 1 Moderate (PM2 per GN010), 1 Supporting (PP3 per GN010); Benign: 0 Stand-alone, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 0 Supporting. Total acmg_score = 3 (PM2=2 + PP3=1). Under ACMG/AMP combining rules, 1 Moderate + 1 Supporting does not reach Likely Pathogenic (which requires >=3 Moderate, 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting, or 1 Moderate + >=4 Supporting) and no benign criteria are met, resulting in VUS (leaning pathogenic). Functional RT-PCR splicing evidence (PS3) or confirmed in-trans proband observations (PM3/PP4) would be required to upgrade classification.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 v2.0 (GN012) and combined with standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules (GN012 defines no separate combining rules). Met criteria by applied strength: Pathogenic = 2 Strong (PS4, PP1) + 3 Moderate (PS2, PM1, PP3); Benign = 1 Moderate (BS2). On the pathogenic side, both Pathogenic rules '>=2 Strong' and '1 Strong + >=3 Moderate' are satisfied. On the benign side, 1 Benign Moderate (BS2) does not reach Likely Benign (>=2 Supporting or 1 Strong + 1 Supporting) or Benign (>=2 Strong), so there is no conflicting classification under ACMG/AMP combining rules, and the net point score is +12 (+4+4+2+2+2-2), supporting a Pathogenic classification.

aiva_rationale: Applied ClinGen Familial Hypercholesterolemia VCEP specifications v1.2 (GN013) for LDLR NM_000527.5:c.1965C>G (p.Phe655Leu, legacy F634L). Met criteria by applied strength: 1 Pathogenic Moderate (PM2 at Moderate per GN013), 2 Pathogenic Supporting (PS4_Supporting, PP1_Supporting), and 0 Benign criteria (VS=0, S=0, M=1, P=2; BA1=0, BS=0, BM=0, BP=0; acmg_score=4). Because GN013 does not define custom combining or points rules, standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply: 1 Moderate + 2 Supporting does not meet Likely Pathogenic (which requires at least 1 Moderate + >=4 Supporting, 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting, or 1 Strong + >=1 Moderate) and meets no Benign or Likely Benign rules, yielding VUS (leaning pathogenic). Computational evidence (REVEL=0.661) lies in the GN013 indeterminate zone (0.50-0.75), and no variant-specific functional assay data were identified.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Congenital Myopathies VCEP RYR1 v2.0 specifications for both autosomal dominant (GN150) and autosomal recessive (GN179) RYR1-related myopathy because mode of inheritance is undetermined; both specifications yield identical met criteria and combining outcomes. GRCh37 VCF coordinates 19:38939278:TGC:T map in Ensembl VEP to the 2-bp intronic polypyrimidine-tract deletion ENST00000359596.3:c.958-10_958-9del (RefSeq NM_000540.3; note input HGVS listed c.958-11del). Applied strength counts: Pathogenic = 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting, +1); Benign = 0 Stand-Alone, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 1 Supporting (BP4_Supporting, -1); acmg_score = 0. Neither pathogenic/likely pathogenic (minimum 1 Moderate + 4 Supporting or 2 Moderate + 2 Supporting) nor benign/likely benign (minimum 2 Benign Supporting or 1 Benign Strong + 1 Benign Supporting) combining rules in GN150/GN179 fire, resulting in Variant of Uncertain Significance. Because there is no clinical, functional, or computational evidence of pathogenicity and SpliceAI predicts no splicing impact (max_delta=0.099 <= 0.1) for this non-canonical intronic deletion (net score 0), the classification is VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Familial Hypercholesterolemia VCEP Specifications v1.2 (GN013), LDLR NM_000527.5:c.1301C>A (p.Thr434Lys) meets 2 Moderate pathogenic criteria (PM2 at Moderate for gnomAD v4.1 PopMax AF=8.474e-07 <=0.0002; PM5 at Moderate for pathogenic missense p.Thr434Arg at codon 434) and 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Supporting pathogenic criteria, with 0 benign criteria (0 BA1, 0 BS, 0 BM, 0 BP); REVEL=0.616 falls in the indeterminate range between GN013 thresholds (<=0.50 for BP4 and >=0.75 for PP3). Because GN013 specifies no custom combining or points rules, standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply: 2 Moderate criteria do not reach Pathogenic or Likely Pathogenic (which requires >=3 Moderate or 2 Moderate plus >=2 Supporting), and no benign rules fire, yielding VUS (leaning pathogenic) with acmg_score=4.

Because GN012 provides criterion-level specifications without custom combining rules, generic ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply: 1 Strong + >=3 Moderate satisfies Pathogenic rule (c), yielding a classification of Pathogenic (ACMG score = 11).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Familial Hypercholesterolemia VCEP v1.2 (GN013), which supersedes generic criterion definitions and strengths (no custom combining rules provided, so standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply). Pathogenic evidence: 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 1 Moderate (PM2 per GN013, gnomAD v4.1 PopMax AF 8.78e-05 <= 0.0002), 0 Supporting — insufficient for Likely Pathogenic or Pathogenic. Benign evidence: 0 Stand-alone, 1 Strong (BS3 per GN013 Level 1 whole-LDLR-cycle CHO-ldlA7 functional assay in PMID:32015373 showing wild-type-equivalent expression, binding, and internalization), 0 Moderate, 0 Supporting — insufficient for Likely Benign (requires 1 BS + 1 BP or >=2 BP) or Benign (>=2 BS). REVEL=0.692 falls in the GN013 indeterminate zone (0.50 to 0.75), meeting neither PP3 nor BP4. Because neither side reaches a definitive or likely classification and benign evidence outweighs pathogenic evidence (ACMG score = +2 - 4 = -2), the variant is classified as VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 v2.0 (GN012), which govern variant interpretation for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1. Two pathogenic criteria are met: PM1 at Moderate strength (residue 2129 within the GN012 central hotspot 2,101-2,458) and PS4 at Supporting strength (1.0 MH case point from 1 proband with clinical MH crisis CGS=45.0 and positive IVCT in PMID:24433488/PMID:12059893, with gnomAD absence <=0.00006). REVEL=0.683 falls in the GN012 indeterminate range (0.5-0.85), meeting neither PP3 (>0.85) nor BP4 (<0.5), and PM2/PP2/PP4/PVS1/PM3/PM4/BS4/BP1/BP3/BP5 are marked Not Applicable by GN012. Applied strength counts are Pathogenic: 0 VS, 0 S, 1 M, 1 P; Benign: 0 BA1, 0 BS, 0 BM, 0 BP (acmg_score = 3). Because GN012 specifies no custom combining rules, generic ACMG/AMP 2015 + ClinGen SVI 2020 combining rules apply: 1 M + 1 P does not meet Likely Pathogenic (which requires at least 1 M + >=4 P, 2 M + >=2 P, or >=3 M) and no benign rule is met, resulting in VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 v2.0 (GN012). Met criteria by applied strength: Pathogenic 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 1 Moderate (PM1: residue 2224 in central hotspot 2,101-2,458), 0 Supporting; Benign 0 Stand-Alone, 1 Strong (BS1: gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF=0.001076 > 0.0008), 0 Moderate, 0 Supporting. Because GN012 does not define custom combining or point rules, standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply: neither Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic thresholds (1 PM alone is insufficient) nor Benign/Likely Benign thresholds (>=2 BS, 1 BS + 1 BP, or >=2 BP; 1 BS alone without BP4 or BS2 is insufficient) are reached. Accordingly, the variant classifies as VUS (leaning benign) driven by the net evidence weight (acmg_score=-2: BS1=-4, PM1=+2).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 v2.0 (GN012), which provide criterion-level overrides without separate combining rules, so standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply. aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP Specifications v2.0 for RYR1 (GN012; PMID:33767344), using generic ACMG/AMP combining rules as GN012 provides no separate combining_rules/points_rules table. Applied strength counts: Pathogenic Supporting = 1 (PM1_Supporting, C-terminal hotspot residues 4,631-4,991 for canonical p.Arg4723His; +1) and Benign Moderate = 1 (BS2_Moderate, one variant-positive individual with a negative IVCT in PMID:25658027; -2). Neither the pathogenic side (1 P; requires >= 1 M + 4 P or >= 2 M + 2 P or >= 3 M or >= 1 S + 2 P for Likely Pathogenic) nor the benign side (1 BM; requires >= 1 BS + 1 BP or >= 2 BP for Likely Benign) reaches a definitive class. With net ACMG score = -1 (benign evidence outweighs pathogenic evidence), the variant is classified as VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Monogenic Diabetes VCEP HNF4A Version 4.0 (GN085), NM_175914.5:c.582+1G>C disrupts the canonical +1 splice donor site of Exon 5 (156 bp = 52 AA, in-frame, >10% of the 452-AA protein), which maps explicitly to PVS1_Strong rather than PVS1 Very Strong, and is absent from gnomAD, meeting PM2_Supporting. Applied strength counts are 0 Pathogenic Very Strong, 1 Pathogenic Strong (PVS1_Strong), 0 Pathogenic Moderate, 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting), and 0 Benign criteria (acmg_score = 5). Per GN085 combining_rules, Likely Pathogenic with 1 Pathogenic Strong requires at least 1 Pathogenic Moderate or >=2 Pathogenic Supporting criteria (and PVS1+PM2_Supporting only reaches Likely Pathogenic when PVS1 is Very Strong). Because 1 Strong + 1 Supporting falls short of Likely Pathogenic by one Supporting criterion with no conflicting benign evidence, the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

Because evidence weight is strongly pathogenic (acmg_score = 9), the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic) pending one additional supporting or moderate pathogenic criterion (e.g., confirmed de novo status, a verified second independent affected proband, or detailed clinical phenotyping).

No benign criteria are met. Under GN027 v2.1 point-based rules, 6 points (within 6-9) classifies this variant as Likely Pathogenic for X-linked creatine transporter deficiency.

aiva_rationale: Strength counts: 0 Pathogenic (0 VS, 0 S, 0 M, 0 P) and 1 Benign Strong (BS1; 0 BA1, 1 S, 0 M, 0 P), yielding acmg_score=-4. Under the ClinGen Rett and Angelman-like Disorders Expert Panel specifications for MECP2 (GN036 v6.0, X-linked Rett syndrome; also McKnight et al. 2022, PMID:34837432), BS1 applies at Strong strength because the variant's allele frequency in gnomAD v4.1 (overall AF=9.07e-6, AC=11; popmax AF=2.95e-5, AN=33,842) and gnomAD exomes continental populations (EAS=3.31e-5, AMR=2.84e-5, SAS=1.85e-5, NFE=9.50e-6) exceeds the MECP2 BS1 cutoff (>=8.3e-6) while remaining below BA1 (>=8.3e-5). Per the GN036 v6.0 combining rules, 1 Strong benign criterion (BS1) with no conflicting pathogenic criteria meets Likely Benign. Computational evidence is indeterminate (REVEL=0.556, between BP4 <=0.290 and PP3 >=0.644), the residue lies in a disordered region outside the MBD and core TRD domains, and no published functional or case evidence supports pathogenicity.

aiva_rationale: clingen_vcep returned no VCEP specification for MECP2, so generic ACMG/AMP 2015 rules were applied. Applied pathogenic strength counts are 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 1 Moderate (PM6), and 2 Supporting (PM2, PS3 at Supporting), with 0 benign criteria met (acmg_score = 4). Under generic ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules, 1 Moderate + 2 Supporting falls short of Likely Pathogenic (which requires 1 Moderate + >=4 Supporting, >=3 Moderate, or 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting) and meets no Benign or Likely Benign rule, resulting in VUS (leaning pathogenic). Computational evidence (REVEL=0.607) is indeterminate between Pejaver 2022 BP4 (<=0.290) and PP3 (>=0.644) thresholds, and functional evidence is limited to a single unreplicated Drosophila partial-LoF assay.

aiva_rationale: Under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specification for ITGA2B and Glanzmann thrombasthenia (GN011 v2.1; Ross et al. 2021, PMC7839359), met criteria are 0 Very Strong, 1 Strong (PVS1_Strong), 0 Moderate, and 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting) pathogenic criteria, and 0 benign criteria (ACMG score = 5). Per GN011 combining rules, Likely Pathogenic with a Strong criterion requires either 1 Strong + 1-2 Moderate or 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting (1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting does not apply because PVS1 is downgraded to Strong due to predicted NMD escape with PTC in final exon 30 while disrupting the critical alphaIIb transmembrane domain aa 994-1019, mirroring ITGA2B c.2852_2853delinsC in PMC7839359 Table 2). Therefore, 1 Strong + 1 Supporting falls short of Likely Pathogenic and classifies as VUS (leaning pathogenic). Note that GRCh37 coordinates 17:42452068:AGG:A map via VEP to ENST00000262407.5:c.2900_2901del (p.Pro967LeufsTer68) whereas the input HGVS string lists NM_000419.5:c.2902del; both are exon 28 frameshifts escaping NMD and disrupting the transmembrane domain, yielding identical criteria (PVS1_Strong, PM2_Supporting) and classification in the absence of patient-level phenotypic (PP4), allelic (PM3), segregation (PP1), or functional (PS3) evidence.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications for ITGA2B/ITGB3 (GN011 v2.1; no VCEP-specific combining rules provided, so standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply). Met pathogenic criteria by applied strength: 0 Very Strong, 1 Strong (PP4_Strong), 1 Moderate (PM3), 2 Supporting (PM2_Supporting, PP3); 0 Benign criteria met. Under ACMG/AMP combining rules, 1 Strong + 1-2 Moderate (and 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting) reaches Likely Pathogenic (acmg_score=8).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Monogenic Diabetes VCEP Specifications for GCK v3.1 (GN086). Applied strength counts: Benign = 1 Strong (BS1) + 2 Supporting (BS3 at Supporting, BP2) = -6 points; Pathogenic = 2 Supporting (PP2, PP3) = +2 points; net ACMG score = -4. The benign side meets GN086 Likely Benign rules (1 Benign Strong + >=1 Benign Supporting, and >=2 Benign Supporting), whereas the pathogenic side (2 Supporting only, consisting of gene-wide missense PP2 and in silico REVEL PP3) does not reach Likely Pathogenic or Pathogenic. While GN086's CSpec table flags any Benign + Pathogenic code pair as conflicting VUS, applying PP2 to every GCK missense variant creates a mechanical conflict even against strong benign evidence; resolving this via separate-side evaluation and the ClinGen SVI Bayesian point framework (net score -4, within the -1 to -6 Likely Benign range) alongside concordant population (BS1), functional neutrality (BS3_Supporting), and in-trans genetic data (BP2) yields Likely Benign.
